<STBG 100,1><BGM 0,0,506><MWT 2>Every year I think it — the unchanging
New Year's osechi dishes—
<MWT 3>New possibilities for osechi!

<STBG 100,2><STBG 15,1><MWT 2>The hunter asked to investigate took
a <COL C70101FF>≪Large Stacked Box≫</COL> and
descended into the uncharted land.

<MWT 2>Seeking new flavours to fill
this <COL C70101FF>stacked box</COL>...
<MWT 2>New flavours.........
<BGM 1,2000,506><STBG 15,2><STBG 100,1><BGM 0,2000,509><MWT 0><TALK 3><NAME 7><CV 1001,27>Hey...! You! Hey, listen to me!
<STBG 100,2><STBG 3,1><CHAR 3,1,18,0,2><MWT 0><NAME 18><CV 1001,38>What's wrong? You were staring off.

<CHAR 3,0,18,0,7><COL C70101FF>You dreamed of exploring the Fractured
Isles with a <COL C70101FF>large black box</COL>?

<CV 1001,5><CHAR 3,0,18,0,1>...! Could that have been a prophetic dream!
I had just the thing to ask you!

<CHAR 3,0,18,0,7><CV 1001,51>My lunch shop... we've been selling osechi
for the New Year, but each year
fewer customers come...

<CV 1001,12><CHAR 3,0,18,0,3>So I thought we'd make a
<COL C70101FF>≪Bold New Osechi≫</COL> and
boost sales!

<CHAR 3,0,18,0,8><CV 1001,33>The Phantom Deep Realm is
<COL C70101FF>an uncharted land that changes form</COL>...?
Uncharted means unseen ingredients!

<CHAR 3,0,18,0,2><CV 1001,52><MWT 2>So I want to seek
<COL C70101FF>new possibilities for osechi</COL>!
<CHAR 3,0,18,0,3><CV 1001,50>I knew you'd say that!

<CHAR 3,6,18,0,0><STBG 100,1><TALK 1><MWT 0><NAME 7><CV 18,25>Searching ingredients and cooking both
would be hard, so this time I called
in a powerful helper!
<CHAR 3,0,18,0,5>This is my helper, Natalie!

<CHAR 3,0,18,0,3><CV 1001,5>She's shy, so she won't show her face
outside the guild, apparently...

<STBG 100,1><TALK 1><MWT 0><NAME 41><CV 18,29><CHAR 3,6,18,0,0>But her talent for inventing recipes
is first-rate!

Once you've explored a bit, please come
to the <COL C70101FF>Lottery</COL>...
I'll work hard on a recipe...

<CHAR 3,2,18,0,0><TALK 5><CHAR 5,1,18,0,4><CV 1001,50><ITEM AD_HEAD1141,1,1>Sh-she left...
Oh, and also! This time I prepared
gear like this!

<CHAR 5,0,18,0,3><CV 1001,17><ITEM WD_PIPE222,1,1>It was sleeping in the lunch shop's
storehouse, but you may use it!

<CHAR 5,0,18,0,0><COL C70101FF>Also, if you explore quite hard,
they seem to throw in an amazing
<COL C70101FF>≪Mastery Unlocked≫</COL> one too!
<ITEM 0,1,1><CHAR 5,2,18,0,0><TALK 3><CHAR 3,1,18,0,3><CV 1001,15>Do peek at <COL C70101FF>Exploration Navi</COL>!

<BGM 1,1000,509><CLS>Alright! Phantom Deep Realm osechi survey!
Let's do our best—!
